title: 자음 쓰는 순서: 칸 안에 바르게 쓰기
objective: Write ㄹ, ㅁ, ㅂ, ㅅ and ㅇ in stroke order, place them in a syllable box, and read easy words with them.
summary: Learn to write, place and say ㄹ, ㅁ, ㅂ, ㅅ and ㅇ.

task.title: Write, place and read
task.line: Answer each question about stroke order, the consonant's place in the box, or the sound of a word.

words.exampleMeaning: There are a lot of people.

letters.sound: [r] before a vowel, [l] at the end

letters.as: Write 3 strokes: left line down → top and right side (ㄱ) → bottom line last.

letters.sound: [b] (between b and p); [p] at the end
letters.as: Write 4 strokes: left line down → right line down → middle line → bottom line.
Write 2 strokes: left stroke down → right stroke from its middle. In the box: consonant on the left with ㅏ ㅓ ㅣ ㅐ ㅔ, on top with ㅗ ㅜ ㅡ.

letters.sound: silent at the start; [ng] at the end
letters.as: Write 1 stroke: start at the top and go counterclockwise.

exercises: How many strokes? Write the number: ① ㅁ ② ㅂ ③ ㅇ
Put the strokes of ㄹ in the right order (a, b, c): (a) ㅡ (b) ㄴ (c) ㄱ
Where does the consonant go in the box? Write left or top: ① 소 ② 비 ③ 무 ④ 레
Read the word aloud, then write its sound in Revised Romanization: ① 머리 ② 소리 ③ 마음
answers: ① top ② left ③ top ④ left
① meori ② sori ③ maeum
